text: 11月13日，中美双方通过视频会议方式举行中美经贸磋商机制项下贸易理事会首次会议。双方以中美元首会晤重要共识为引领，围绕落实前期中美经贸磋商成果，就关税、“300亿对300亿”对等降税安排、农产品贸易以及各自关心的其他议题进行了坦诚、深入、建设性的交流。
text_en: On November 13, China and the United States held the first meeting of the Trade Council under the China-US economic and trade consultation mechanism via video conference. Guided by the important consensus reached at the meeting between the Chinese and US heads of state, the two sides focused on implementing the outcomes of previous China-US economic and trade consultations and conducted candid, in-depth and constructive exchanges on tariffs, the "300 billion versus 300 billion" reciprocal tariff reduction arrangement, agricultural trade and other issues of respective concern.
